items.title: Cannot open links with address from calendar app

labels.name: Observed
labels.description: Needs more clarification, feedback, or research

items.body:
> What version of OsmAnd are you using, on what device and Android/iOS version?

Android, 3.5.5

> Do you use the offline maps offered within the OsmAnd app for download, or online (tile / raster) maps?

Offline maps

Opening any address from calendar app (event's location) results in Osmand either navigating me to Kazakhstan or showing me a search view with no results. I've tried changing the format of the address to:

* Półwiejska 45, 61-886 Poznan, Poland
* Półwiejska 45, 61-886 Poznań, Poland
* Półwiejska 45, Poznan, Poland
* Półwiejska 45, Poznań, Poland
* Półwiejska 45, Poznań

And neither of them worked - I wasn't shown the address on the map, just either Kazakhstan or failed search

items.title: Layer in OsmAnd 'Desert' problems displaying roads in fields and steppes
items.body:
### Description

**Preamble.**
OsmAnd has a "Tourist" layer - this is a good style of rendering everything, all roads and objects are distinguishable. But also in OsmAnd there is a “Desert” style, this style among tourists, sportsmen, travelers, perhaps, can have a higher popularity, since it has the advantage: the objects that activists need are specially highlighted on the map (water, tables, a place for a camp) , as well as more contrasting colors (for easier reading of the map outdoors/in the sun).
But the "Desert" layer has a fatal flaw, essentially a defect, this is the display of roads, incl. and asphalt (roads between populated areas in forests, steppes and fields). Because of this, this style cannot be used; the problem will be described below.

A small one important comparison why OsmAnd maps outperform Organic Maps:
Because in OsmAnd all roads and paths are distinguishable from each other, but Organic Maps has a problem with this. Here's a simple example:
![diff](https://github.com/osmandapp/OsmAnd/assets/61022210/d1c5babd-47ed-4c88-ab3d-dcc55d75c30d)

Left Organic Maps, right OsmAnd. Rendering of roads and clearings near Mukhtolovo. In OsmAnd, roads and clearings are visible and everything is distinguishable where which road is, forest or asphalt. In Organic Maps, roads and clearings are indistinguishable even from each other (out of the box).

A good example of comparing what is good and what is bad, OsmAnd uses the “Tourist” style. But what if you use the “Desert” (improved tourist) style in OsmAnd and compare. _Fiasco. Complete failure._

### Comparison of tourist styles in OsmAnd (on the left - 'Desert'; on the right - "Tourist")
![04](https://github.com/osmandapp/OsmAnd/assets/61022210/8ad4fb70-721d-4168-b1bd-031804286564)

![03](https://github.com/osmandapp/OsmAnd/assets/61022210/aabebbdd-e51f-4441-be7d-fbb907abaad1)

![02](https://github.com/osmandapp/OsmAnd/assets/61022210/7371f09d-5b4d-4c82-8372-080dba9cf1bf)

![01](https://github.com/osmandapp/OsmAnd/assets/61022210/3876bdd7-3dc8-412c-883c-a4800e840865)

As can be seen from the comparison, white roads are indistinguishable in fields and steppes (they merge with the environment). I believe that you are peering at the screenshots to discern where the roads are in 'Desert', straining your eyesight from the room/from the sofa. For cyclists/motorcyclists/hikers on a sunny day, it is generally impossible to make out the dynamics; it’s as soon as the defect is eliminated.


At a minimum, there are problems with visualizing roads with these tags:
```
Tag:highway=unclassified
Tag:highway=tertiary
Tag:highway=residential
```
These roads in the desert layer merge with the surrounding terrain in the steppes (the problem here is a whole country, like Kazakhstan) and fields.

### Steps to reproduce

Select the 'Desert' layer in the styles and look at the roads in the fields and steppes.

### Actual result

Roads blend into the environment and are not visible.

### Expected result

Correct the white color of roads or fields/steppes so that roads are distinguishable in steppes and fields and between populated areas.
(Let me remind you that this style wins over the “tourist” layer due to the contrast of reading the map in nature on a bright day and highlighting on the map (water, overnight stops, tables for travelers to rest)).

### Your Environment (required)

```
OsmAnd Version: the last one with f-droid
Android/iOS version: LOS16
```

items.title: Add Kazakh language to the map configuration
items.body:
There isn't Kazakh language in the map configuration. It doesn't allow to use map of Kazakhstan in Kazakh language using values from name:kk tag.

Now Kazakhstan map is mostly based on Russian names in name tag. Some contributors of local community want to switch the map to Kazakh language that is official language in Kazakhstan.

Ability to use map in Kazakh without changing values at the name tag allow to perform switching smoother: firstly add Kazakh names to name:kk tag (and already start to use Kazakh names in some apps) then move Russian names to name:ru, etc.
